country_name_duplicates.evidence: country_mapping dict maps 'Saudi Arabien'→'Saudi Arabia', 'Marrocos'→'Morocco', 'Turkménistan'→'Turkmenistan', 'Турция'→'Turkey'; none of these variant names appear in the printed top 10 hottest countries by average list.

outlier_79c.evidence: "Anomaly exclusion: 1 anomalous reading(s) excluded (Suva, 79.3°C, >18 std dev from location mean — likely sensor/data error)" and Suva does not appear in the printed max-city list.

city_name_duplicates.evidence: Printed top 10 hottest cities by average still shows '1. Ar Riyadh: 45.0 deg C' and '2. Kuwait: 44.4 deg C' — the single-observation duplicates of Riyadh and Kuwait City were never merged or removed.

accuracy.justification: The team correctly identified and removed the Suva 79.3°C outlier and merged non-English country name variants (fixing the country-average trap), but failed to catch the analogous city-name duplicate issue, leaving 'Ar Riyadh' and 'Kuwait' as the top 2 hottest cities by average — a clear artifact of single-observation entries that undermines that specific chart's validity.

cohesion.justification: There is no written report connecting the code outputs to a narrative; the report section contains only a placeholder, making it impossible to assess how (or whether) the team intended to explain results to a non-technical audience.

quality.justification: The data cleaning methodology (outlier removal, country name consolidation) shows real effort and reasonable judgment, but the missed city-duplicate trap and the complete absence of the required summary substantially reduce the overall quality and usability of the deliverable.

completeness.justification: All 4 required charts were saved and all 4 top-10 lists were printed to console as required, but the written 100-word non-technical summary — an explicitly required deliverable — is entirely absent from the submission (placeholder text only).

summary: The team executed solid data-cleaning steps for two of the three known traps (outlier removal and country-name consolidation) and delivered all 4 charts plus console-printed rankings, but missed the city-name duplicate trap (Ar Riyadh/Kuwait skewing the average-city ranking) and failed to produce the required 100-word summary, leaving the deliverable incomplete and disjointed.
